title: Blackjack Hand Value
description: Score a Blackjack hand. J/Q/K=10, numbers as-is, Aces are 11 unless that busts — then count that ace as 1. Demotes one ace at a time until the total fits or runs out.

notes: Count aces as 11 first, then demote one-by-one ONLY while the hand busts. Demoting all aces upfront under-scores ['A','9'] (would give 10 instead of 20).
`'JQK'.includes(c)` is a tight way to test face cards without an array.
The while loop terminates either when total ≤ 21 or aces hit 0 — the bust is unavoidable.

questions.q: What does the Ace contribute initially?
options: 11 always — and is demoted to 1 only if the hand busts
11 if it is the first card, else 1
0 until the rest of the hand is scored

questions.q: Why demote aces one at a time instead of all at once?
options: Each ace is independent — `['A','A','9']` should be 21 (one ace at 11, one at 1), not 11
Demoting all at once is slower
The rules forbid changing more than one ace

exercises.prompt: Fill in handValue so the four test cases print 21, 15, 21, 22.

blanks.hint: 11 - 1 — the amount we drop per demoted ace

hints: Sum aces as 11 first, count them, then demote one at a time while busted.
Use `Number(c)` to parse '10' through '2' to integers.
